$comment: Host literals the secure build's output (dist-secure) may contain. Read by
scripts/auditBundleEgress.js after every secure build; a host literal not listed here
fails the build. Same shape as scripts/egress-allowlist.json (the contract for the public
inert  (default) never a request: an XML namespace or marker identifier, a link inside
library code, a citation in shader text, a display string, a pattern used to
recognise a pasted address. mayReceive must be ["none"].
link   a navigation the USER starts by clicking; the page never fetches it. mayReceive
states what such a click carries, so the disclosure is written down.
gated  fetch or link code is present but sits on a path closed at compile time; gate
names the control: isSecureBuild (src/configUtils.js), or a setting the secure
build forces to false (scripts/secureClientEnv.js), which the runtime ratchet in
src/envUtils.js refuses to loosen. mayReceive must be ["none"].
A host the application would contact at run time is never an entry of any class: it is a
finding, and the fix is to remove the code that names it (scripts/secureStubs.js). Exact
hosts only; no wildcards. Seeded from a real dist-secure build on 2026-09-02; every entry
was read in the source before it was classified. See docs/dev/Secure-Build.md.
